children: said on Tuesday it would acquire a Canadian factory from supplier Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI)
, which manufactures wings for the private jet maker's Global 5500 and 6500 aircraft.
Through the deal, financial details for which were not disclosed, Bombardier will acquire the assets of MHI Canada Aerospace's facility in Mississauga, Ontario.
